mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation was most worthwhile because the resulting route brings together air movement, gas exchange and delivery to tissues.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter. The constructions made the connection between chest movement, gas exchange and circulation interesting, even though the two unexpected ordering requirements interrupted that flow.
